response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad engineering experience including genuine high-throughput distributed systems work (Dunnhumby, millions of requests/sec) and is currently in a Staff role directly building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset this role requires. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python experience despite it being a must-have, and lacks clear signals of stakeholder management, cross-functional leadership, on-call/incident response, or agile ceremony participation that the role demands.
strengths: Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow frameworks
Proven high-throughput distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Already holds a Staff Engineer title with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
concerns: No Python listed or referenced anywhere in skills or work history despite it being a core must-have
No explicit evidence of stakeholder management, cross-functional coordination, or bridging engineering/product perspectives
No mention of on-call/incident response ownership or agile/scrum ceremony experience
